news.title: Jet fuel supply concerns grow as war on Iran drags on, airlines cut flights - CNBC
news.zh: 隨著伊朗戰爭持續，噴氣燃料供應憂慮加劇，航空公司削減航班
news.impact: 油價上升推高航空營運成本，航空股承壓

news.title: Humana, UnitedHealth Soar as US Raises Medicare Advantage Rates - Bloomberg.com
news.zh: 美國提高醫療保險優勢計畫費率，Humana和UnitedHealth股價飆升
news.impact: 保險公司獲利前景改善，醫療保險股上漲

news.title: Intel to join Musk's Terafab mega AI chip project - Yahoo Finance
news.zh: Intel加入Musk的Terafab超級人工智能晶片項目
news.impact: Intel涉足AI晶片產業，與Musk合作搶佔市場

news.title: Delta raises checked bag fees $10 amid jet fuel price surge, joining other carriers - CNBC
news.zh: Delta航空因噴氣燃料價格飆升，調高託運行李費10美元，與其他航空公司接軌
news.impact: 航空公司調漲費用轉嫁成本，消費者負擔增加

news.title: The Iran war shock is about half the size of Covid-19 - Financial Times
news.zh: 伊朗戰爭衝擊規模約為新冠疫情的一半
news.impact: 地緣政治風險評估，經濟衝擊可控但仍需關注

news.title: CNN hosts left visibly stunned after US labor market bounces back with 178K jobs added in March. How to capitalize - Yahoo Finance
news.zh: CNN主持人驚訝美國勞動力市場反彈，3月新增178,000個工作機會，分析如何受益
news.impact: 就業數據強勁，經濟韌性顯現，市場樂觀情緒提升

news.title: ‘All roads lead to higher prices and slower growth,' warns IMF chief as Iran war hits global economy - CNBC
news.zh: IMF首長警告伊朗戰爭衝擊全球經濟，「所有道路都通向更高物價和更慢增長」
news.impact: 全球經濟面臨滯脹風險，央行決策將受影響

news.title: Goldman Warns on Copper as Iran War Threatens Global Economy - bloomberg.com
news.zh: 高盛警告銅價風險，伊朗戰爭威脅全球經濟
news.impact: 大宗商品價格波動加劇，商品生產企業成本上升

news.title: SEC crypto safe harbor heads to White House review, proposal due 'shortly' says Atkins - The Block
news.zh: SEC加密貨幣安全港提案送交白宮審查，Atkins表示提案「即將」公布
news.impact: 加密貨幣監管框架推進，產業監管環境逐步明確

news.title: Exclusive | Amazon and U.S. Postal Service Reach Delivery Deal - WSJ
news.zh: 獨家報導｜亞馬遜與美國郵政服務達成配送協議
news.impact: 亞馬遜物流網絡擴展，物流成本可能優化

news.title: JPMorgan CEO Dimon: Iran war could reignite inflation and keep Fed rates higher for longer - ABC News
news.zh: 摩根大通CEO戴蒙：伊朗戰爭可能重燃通膨並使聯準會利率保持高位更久
news.impact: 地緣政治風險加劇通膨壓力，聯準會政策收緊

news.title: Neurocrine, eying ‘blockbuster in the making,’ strikes its largest-ever M&A deal with $2.9B Soleno buyout - Fierce Pharma
news.zh: 神經制藥公司瞄準「潛力大作」，以29億美元收購Soleno創歷史最大併購
news.impact: 生物製藥領域重大併購，擴展藥物組合

news.title: Paramount Skydance Secures $24 Billion From Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Abu Dhabi Funds for Warner Bros. Deal - Variety
news.zh: 派拉蒙天空舞者公司從沙烏地阿拉伯、卡達和阿布達比基金獲得240億美元用於華納兄弟交易
news.impact: 好萊塢重大交易，中東資金大舉進場

news.title: The Federal Reserve's March and April Inflation Forecast Is In -- and Things Just Keep Getting Uglier for Wall Street - The Motley Fool
news.zh: 聯準會3月和4月通膨預測出爐，華爾街局勢持續惡化

news.title: EU rules on pick-up trucks draw US automaker pushback
news.zh: 歐盟皮卡車規定引發美國汽車製造商反彈

news.title: BofA hikes 2026 chips forecast to $1.3 trillion, names Nvidia, Broadcom, Marvell, AMD as top drivers
news.zh: 美銀將2026年芯片產業預測調升至1.3兆美元，點名輝達、博通、Marvell和AMD為主要驅動力
news.impact: 芯片產業成長強勁，龍頭廠商受惠

news.title: These products could get hit hardest by Trump’s new Iran tariff threat
news.zh: 這些產品可能受到川普新伊朗關稅威脅的最大打擊
news.impact: 貿易政策風險，特定產業面臨成本壓力

news.title: Your local banker is getting worried that credit stress will bring the economy to its knees
news.zh: 當地銀行家擔心信用壓力將經濟推向懸崖
news.impact: 信用市場風險升溫，經濟衰退預警

news.title: Oil Slumps, Stock Markets Surge As First Ships Transit Hormuz
news.zh: 首批船隻通過荷姆茲海峽，油價下跌、股市上漲
news.impact: 地緣政治緩解，能源價格回軟

news.title: Gold Tops $4,800 as U.S.-Iran Ceasefire Halts Six Weeks of War
news.zh: 美伊停火協議達成，黃金突破4800美元創新高
